_comment: Shadow Spears — WH40K ornate-ceremonial dataslate. Aged-COPPER heraldry over a grimdark bone/near-black palette (deliberate pack palette, NOT Catppuccin). Flat MATTE 'slab' material (no glass), gothic-arch copper corner ornaments, weightier 'ritual' motion, serif display headers. Open/non-IP assets only. See docs/THEME_PACK.md.
_colors_note: Cool slate-black base (not brown) with a warm bone text + copper accent — parchment-on-gunmetal contrast.
_font_note: displayFamily is a stand-in serif; drop a gothic/blackletter OFL face in fonts/ + set font.displayFile for the real one. Body stays mono for legibility.
